extract_step_entities: run the script to extract ENTITY tokens from a STEP file and write them to step_entitylist.txt
search_entity_lines: run the script to search for lines containing the ENTITY keyword in a STEP file
parse_step_tokens: run the script to parse space-delimited tokens from ENTITY lines in a STEP file
write_entity_list: run the script to write extracted entity names to step_entitylist.txt in append mode
review_step_importer_script: review the StepImporter extract_step_token script for parsing STEP entity data
